organic.title: Top-down Discourse Parsing via Sequence Labelling
organic.snippet: In this paper, we propose a conceptually simpler top-down approach for RST parsing. The core idea is to frame the problem as a sequence labelling task, where the goal is to iteratively find a segmentation boundary to split a sequence of discourse units into two sub-sequences of discourse units.
